# Ergo Developer Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive developer documentation for the Ergo blockchain ecosystem,
> including SDKs, ErgoScript smart contracts, node APIs, integration patterns,
> ecosystem dApp architecture, and community knowledge from 8+ years of
> Telegram history and video transcripts.

## Reference
- [ergoplatform/eips — Overview](content/reference/eips/overview.md): All Ergo Improvement Proposals as structured reference docs (~2078 tokens)
- [ErgoScript Language Specification](content/reference/ergoscript/language-spec.md): Complete reference for the ErgoScript smart contract language: types, operations, context variables, predefined functions, Box/SigmaProp/AvlTree/Coll APIs, and known limitations. (~13392 tokens)
- [ergoplatform/sigmastate-interpreter — Overview](content/reference/ergoscript/overview.md): ErgoScript compiler internals, ErgoTree spec, test cases as usage examples (~2041 tokens)
- [ergoplatform/ergo — Overview](content/reference/node-api/overview.md): Ergo node — REST API endpoints (Swagger), config options, mining parameters (~1933 tokens)

## SDK Documentation
- [ergoplatform/ergo-appkit — Overview](content/sdks/appkit/overview.md): JVM SDK — transaction building, contract compilation, wallet interaction (~2022 tokens)
- [fleet-sdk/docs — Overview](content/sdks/fleet-sdk/overview.md): Fleet SDK VitePress documentation — migrate and cross-reference (~2075 tokens)
- [ergo-pad/ergo-python-appkit — Overview](content/sdks/python/overview.md): Python AppKit wrapper (ergpy) — JPype bridge, transaction building patterns (~1870 tokens)
- [ergoplatform/sigma-rust — Overview](content/sdks/sigma-rust/overview.md): Rust sigma-state implementation — WASM bindings, wallet features, ErgoTree interpreter (~1934 tokens)

## Integration Patterns
- [AMM / LP mechanics](content/patterns/amm-lp-mechanics.md): AMM / LP mechanics — swap math, liquidity provision, LP token minting, fee extraction, pool state boxes (~2015 tokens)
- [Constant segregation](content/patterns/constant-segregation.md): Constant segregation — substConstants pattern for contract templates without recompilation (~2348 tokens)
- [EIP-12 dApp Connector](content/patterns/eip12-dapp-connector.md): EIP-12 dApp Connector — connection API, context API, multi-wallet detection, TypeScript types (~2259 tokens)
- [ErgoAuth (EIP-28)](content/patterns/ergoauth-authentication.md): ErgoAuth (EIP-28) — user authentication via SigmaProp signature, challenge-response flow (~2111 tokens)
- [ErgoPay (EIP-20)](content/patterns/ergopay-signing.md): ErgoPay (EIP-20) — mobile signing, URI scheme, dynamic vs static requests, desktop↔mobile flow (~2341 tokens)
- [Headless dApp pattern](content/patterns/headless-dapp.md): Headless dApp pattern — pure protocol logic separated from UI, composable and testable (~2234 tokens)
- [Off-chain bots](content/patterns/offchain-bots.md): Off-chain bots — chain scanning → state detection → tx assembly → submission (~2452 tokens)
- [On-chain state tracking](content/patterns/onchain-state-tracking.md): On-chain state tracking — scanning frameworks, box tracking by token/address, state reconstruction (~2304 tokens)
- [Oracle data consumption](content/patterns/oracle-data-consumption.md): Oracle data consumption — reading price feeds and external state via Data inputs without spending (~2430 tokens)
- [Plasma / AVL tree state](content/patterns/plasma-avl-tree.md): Plasma / AVL tree state — off-chain authenticated data with on-chain proof verification, PlasmaMap pattern (~2198 tokens)
- [Proxy contracts](content/patterns/proxy-contracts.md): Proxy contracts — user-facing entry points with refund paths, deadline guards, and forwarding to protocol contracts (~2359 tokens)
- [Singleton / State NFT](content/patterns/singleton-state-nft.md): Singleton / State NFT — identity tokens for multi-stage contract state boxes, one-token-per-box invariant (~2227 tokens)
- [Token minting (EIP-4)](content/patterns/token-minting-eip4.md): Token minting (EIP-4) — NFT and fungible token issuance, metadata registers, Token ID rule (~2030 tokens)
- [Transaction building](content/patterns/transaction-building.md): Transaction building — Fleet SDK + AppKit patterns, box selection, fee handling, token ops (~2389 tokens)
